audience: developers and teams that run browser automation, page checks or web research with Browserbase

useCases.title: Monitor running browser sessions
useCases.text: List the sessions on the account, newest first. Open one session to read its status, region and timing.

useCases.title: Check browser time used by a project
useCases.text: List the projects to find a project id. Read the usage figures of one project: sessions, browser time and proxy bytes.

useCases.title: Read a web page through a cloud browser
useCases.text: Fetch one web page through Browserbase. The result gives the status code, headers, content and content type.

useCases.title: Search the web for articles
useCases.text: Run a web search. The result lists the matching pages with their titles, URLs and excerpts.

useCases.title: Start and release a browser session
useCases.text: Start a cloud browser session. Starting a session starts billed browser time. Release it when the work ends to stop that billing.
